commands.command: uv run --project python pytest tests/evaluation -q  # 18 passed: every pinned dataset loads and is digest-pinned, the digest is a pure function of the pinned content (payload, case order and version each change it), a drifted digest is refused at load, an unpinned dataset is refused, the dataset and case shapes are closed and validated, a case payload stays opaque to the harness, a duplicate identity is refused, and the injection corpus is the repository's rather than a copy

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=... (cd python && uv run --frozen pytest -q)  # 448 passed, 6 skipped
(cd python && ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy intelligence)
